versioning.price_change_rule: No price change without explicit human_approval_ref

required_before_production: 3. Human review flags resolved (plomberie.robinet and plomberie.chasse_eau)
4. Rounding policy approved by human decision
5. Shadow engine: run canonical formulas against test cases, compare to legacy outputs
6. Legacy output comparison: flag all P0/P1 discrepancies before replacing legacy
7. UI copy approved: all copy_key strings reviewed and approved
8. Telemetry ready: service_sub_code in missions table

rounding_policy.recommendation: Option A — nearest integer MAD. Minimum floors dominate small jobs for peinture/nettoyage; integer MAD is precise enough for larger jobs.
